translations.actividades.publica-diagramas.resumen: Your original diagrams, published in the official event book.
translations.actividades.publica-diagramas.p1: Did you create an amazing origami model? This is your chance to see it published! Share your original diagrams in our book "Páginas De Origami 2026". You'll reach origami artists worldwide and your creation will be part of the official event book.
translations.actividades.publica-diagramas.p2: How to participate? Easy: download the Call for Submissions guidelines (Spanish or English), prepare your diagrams and send them before May 20, 2026 to Camilo Torres: paginasdeorigami@gmail.com. Go ahead and share your art!
translations.actividades.publica-diagramas.nota: ✳ Dates from the 2026 edition — to be confirmed for 2027.
translations.actividades.tallerista.resumen: Teach your models in the basic, intermediate, advanced or kids categories.
translations.actividades.tallerista.p1: Are you passionate about teaching origami? This is your moment! Sign up to be a workshop teacher in our categories (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, Kids) and share your magic with other folders. When registering, tell us what cool figures you want to teach — or if you prefer, send us the details later! Go ahead and inspire others with your folds.
translations.actividades.pines.resumen: Fold little figures to wear as brooches and hand them out to make friends.
translations.actividades.pines.p1: Feeling a little shy about starting a conversation? We have the solution! Join the pin exchange: fold a bunch of cute origami figurines that can be worn as brooches. Hand them out to whoever you want at the opening or throughout the entire event. It's the perfect excuse to connect, make friends and take home a unique souvenir!
translations.actividades.chocogami.resumen: Fold using nothing but the wrapper of a Colombian chocolate bar.
translations.actividades.chocogami.p1: Get ready for a delicious and creative challenge! In Chocogami, you unwrap a popular Colombian chocolate bar, discover a secret photo and... start folding! The golden rule: you can only use the chocolate wrapper. Show off your ingenuity, compete for fun prizes or simply have a great time watching the creations (and eating chocolate!). Do you dare?
translations.actividades.tarjetas-atc.resumen: Put together packs of origami cards and trade them for a unique collection.
translations.actividades.tarjetas-atc.p1: Make your ATCs (Artist Trading Cards) unforgettable! Design and assemble origami card packets (16 cards per packet, in groups of 2). At the end, packets of 16 or 32 different cards are exchanged between participants, and everyone takes home a unique collection! Also enter the contest for best card and let your creativity shine. Download the submission guidelines and start folding connections full of art.
translations.actividades.chiva.resumen: A night of Colombian dancing and partying on wheels, adults only.
translations.actividades.chiva.p1: Ready for a night of pure Colombian party? The Chiva Rumbera is our colorful, musical bus for a night out full of dancing and fun. It's an extra activity (adults only!) perfect for letting loose after a day of folding. Don't miss it if you want some serious fun!
translations.actividades.chiva.nota: ✳ Optional activity, adults only — check the details.
translations.actividades.encuentro-invitados.resumen: Special classes to fold a model directly with the guests.
translations.actividades.encuentro-invitados.p1: A golden opportunity! We will have special classes with our star guests (international and national). Imagine learning their secrets, hearing their stories and folding a special model directly with them in a large group. Get ready for a concentrated dose of inspiration and knowledge from those who know best!
translations.actividades.talleres.resumen: Workshops by level, from beginner to expert, with original models.
translations.actividades.talleres.p1: Are you new to the world of origami or already a super-pro folder? It doesn't matter! Our workshops are divided by level (Beginner, Intermediate, Expert) so you can enjoy learning figures at your own pace. The best part: many teachers teach models they created themselves. These are unique opportunities to learn figures you won't find anywhere else!
translations.actividades.exposicion.resumen: Display your best creations and vote for the best exhibit.
translations.actividades.exposicion.p1: This is your stage! Bring your best creations and display them for everyone to admire. Remember to put a label with the key details (author, folder, paper type...). Your models can also win prizes! There will be votes throughout the event to choose the best exhibition (creativity counts!). Don't forget to vote for your favorites and let your work inspire others.
translations.actividades.origami-kids.resumen: A corner with workshops, games and figures for kids.
translations.actividades.origami-kids.p1: The future of origami is here! We have a special corner for children, with super fun workshops, games and figures designed for their creative little hands. And if you love teaching and have a gift with kids, go ahead and become a volunteer teacher at Origami Kids! It's a rewarding experience full of laughter and colorful paper.
translations.actividades.subasta.resumen: Books, papers and models donated by artists, to the best secret bid.
translations.actividades.subasta.p1: Looking for that origami gem you can't find anywhere? Join our Silent Auction! You'll find books, specialty papers, exclusive models donated by artists and many more surprises. Write your bid in secret, cross your fingers and take home something unique! You'll also be supporting the origami community.
translations.actividades.origami-pasillo.resumen: Quick tricks and new figures in any corner of the event.
translations.actividades.origami-pasillo.p1: Sometimes the best discoveries happen outside the classrooms. "Hallway Origami" is that magical moment where you share a quick trick, learn a figure from a new friend or simply chat about papers and folds in any corner of the event. Keep your eyes open and your paper ready — connection and learning happen everywhere!
translations.actividades.explora-bogota.resumen: Tips and optional outings to see the city between folds.
translations.actividades.explora-bogota.p1: Want to make the most of your trip to explore the capital? Of course! We'll give you tips and maybe organize some optional tours to discover Bogotá's charms. Explore the culture, try the local food and take home memories that go beyond origami. A chance to stretch your legs and see the city between folds!
translations.actividades.explora-bogota.nota: ✳ Optional activity — check the schedule for more details.
translations.actividades.rifas.resumen: Books, papers and tools for whoever keeps an ear out for announcements.
translations.actividades.rifas.p1: Stay alert and attentive throughout the event! We will organize raffles and surprise draws at different moments. You could win origami books, specialty papers, unique tools and much more. The key to not missing anything: stay tuned for announcements and activities! Join workshops, attend talks and keep your ears wide open. Luck smiles on those who are present and active! Don't miss out on taking home a great prize.
translations.actividades.frase: from Chocogami to the party bus, there's something for everyone!
translations.actividades.lema: Browse everything we've got ready for you
translations.actividades.intro: From the sweet Chocogami challenge to the party bus: search, filter and find your fold, June 4–6.
